configurations.name: app
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'app'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8770')))

configurations.name: app-sandbox
runtimeArgs: import os, shutil, sys, tempfile; d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fot-sandbox-'); shutil.copytree('app/data', d, dirs_exist_ok=True); shutil.copy('docs/ui/demo_input.xlsx', os.path.join(d, 'reference.xlsx')); os.environ['FOT_DATA_DIR'] = d; os.environ['FOT_REFERENCE_TEMPLATE'] = os.path.join(d, 'reference.xlsx'); print('FOT_DATA_DIR', d, flush=True); sys.path.insert(0, 'app'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8771')))

configurations.name: app-sandbox-qwen
runtimeArgs: import os, shutil, sys, tempfile; import faulthandler; faulthandler.enable(); os.environ['FOT_LLM_PROVIDER'] = 'local'; os.environ.setdefault('FOT_LLM_RCVBUF', '1200'); os.environ.setdefault('FOT_LLM_MODEL_LOCAL', 'qwen38'); os.environ['FOT_LLM_MODEL'] = os.environ['FOT_LLM_MODEL_LOCAL']; d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fot-sandbox-'); shutil.copytree('app/data', d, dirs_exist_ok=True); shutil.copy('docs/ui/demo_input.xlsx', os.path.join(d, 'reference.xlsx')); os.environ['FOT_DATA_DIR'] = d; os.environ['FOT_REFERENCE_TEMPLATE'] = os.path.join(d, 'reference.xlsx'); print('FOT_DATA_DIR', d, flush=True); sys.path.insert(0, 'app'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8772')))
